name: DapuStor Corporation
summary: DapuStor Corporation designs and manufactures solid-state drives (SSD), SOC, and edge computing-related products. Its products include Haishen5 Series, solid state drives (SSD); QLC series, a QLC SSDfor read-centric applications; Roealsen & Jiaorong Series, an eSSD for critical businesses; Xlenstor SLC Series, an eSSD; and SSD Controller Series. It caters to servers, telecom, operators, and data centers in Beijing, Suzhou, Chengdu, and Nanjing, China; Hong Kong; Taipei; America; and Singapore. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
